book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: بمحطة قطار صغيرة، في دفتر معلق للشكاوى.
sentences.en: At a small railway station, a complaints book hung on the wall.
The key had been lost long ago.

sentences.ar: واحد كتب: قبعتي ضاعت وأنا نايم.
sentences.en: One person wrote: my hat was lost while I slept.

sentences.ar: واحد تاني كتب تحتها: مين قال إنك نمت؟
sentences.en: Another wrote beneath it: who said you slept?

sentences.ar: واحد كتب قصيدة حب لبنت اسمها كاتيا.
sentences.en: Someone wrote a love poem to a girl named Katya.

sentences.ar: واحد كتب: الموظف هون وقح وما بيرد.
sentences.en: Someone wrote: the clerk here is rude and does not answer.

sentences.ar: وواحد كتب: أنا مش راكب، أنا بس بمرق.
sentences.en: And someone wrote: I am not a passenger, I am only passing.
And someone drew a face with big eyes.

sentences.ar: ولا شكوى وحدة كانت عن القطار.
sentences.en: Not one complaint was about the train.

sentences.ar: الدفتر ضل معلق سنين، وما حدا قراه.
sentences.en: The book hung there for years, and nobody read it.
